title: Local negative-Ext vanishing and descent of morphisms between global derived objects
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $\mathcal C$ be a set of open subsets covering $X$, and suppose $U\cap V=\bigcup_{W\in\mathcal C,\,W\subset U\cap V}W$ for all $U,V\in\mathcal C$. Let $M,N\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category] satisfy $\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal O_U)}(M|_U,N|_U[i])=0$ for every $U\in\mathcal C$ and every integer $i<0$. For every open $O\subset X$ which is a union of members of $\mathcal C$, one has $\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal O_O)}(M|_O,N|_O[i])=0$ for $i<0$. Moreover restriction is a bijection from $\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal O_O)}(M|_O,N|_O)$ to the families $(a_U)_{U\in\mathcal C,\,U\subset O}$ with $a_U:M|_U\to N|_U$ and $a_U|_V=a_V$ whenever $V\subset U$ are in this indexing family. These assertions include $O=\varnothing$ and the empty covering family when $X=\varnothing$.
